name: Xaura SaaS Dashboard
description: A polished SaaS dashboard template with sidebar navigation, topbar with search/notifications/profile menu, KPI stat cards with sparklines, SVG analytics charts (revenue, traffic sources), sortable/filterable data table with pagination, activity feed, and realistic loading, empty, and error states. Fully responsive with a mobile drawer navigation and night mode. Built on the Xaura design system.
features: sidebar navigation with active states and mobile drawer
topbar with global search, notifications dropdown, and profile menu
KPI stat cards with delta badges and sparklines
SVG analytics charts with time-range tabs and hover tooltips
sortable, searchable, filterable data table with pagination
loading skeletons, empty state, and error state with retry
fully customizable content via data-fws-slot attributes
